answer: Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Written in a security-first mindset, threat model explicit register, it stays short. The design leans on oracle aggregation with outlier rejection. Reaching the juniper of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A saffron of per-task receipts records who did what, and the reef of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
